t: What he asked not to happen to his own grave
a: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْ قَبْرِي وَثَنًا يُعْبَدُ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَى قَوْمٍ اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ
p: Allāhumma lā tajʿal qabrī wathanan yuʿbad. Ishtadda ghaḍabu-Llāhi ʿalā qawmin-ittakhadhū qubūra anbiyāʾihim masājid
m: O Allah, do not make my grave an idol that is worshipped. The anger of Allah grew severe against a people who took the graves of their prophets as places of worship.
